positions.as_written: Treat the ligament as a restraint whose share of the load changes through range rather than as a fixed stop.
Assess the corners before accepting that a posterior cruciate injury is isolated.
Document the resting step off as well as the translation, because the two together say whether the ligament or the capsule and corners have failed.
